name: AI Cybersecurity Workshop
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; cd starter; echo "=== Installing Django dependencies ==="; python -m pip install -r requirements.txt; echo "=== Configuring Django ==="; python -c "from pathlib import Path; from dotenv import dotenv_values, set_key; from django.core.management.utils import get_random_secret_key; p = Path(\".env\"); p.exists() or p.write_text(Path(\".env.example\").read_text() if Path(\".env.example\").exists() else \"\"); dotenv_values(p).get(\"DJANGO_SECRET_KEY\") or set_key(str(p), \"DJANGO_SECRET_KEY\", get_random_secret_key())"; python manage.py migrate; echo "=== Installing Ollama ==="; curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh -o /tmp/install-ollama.sh; sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y zstd; sh /tmp/install-ollama.sh; echo "=== Starting Ollama ==="; if ! curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags > /dev/null 2>&1; then nohup ollama serve > /tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & fi; ready=0; for i in $(seq 1 60); do if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags > /dev/null 2>&1; then ready=1; break; fi; sleep 1; done; if [ "$ready" -ne 1 ]; then cat /tmp/ollama.log; exit 1; fi; echo "=== Downloading Qwen3 0.6B ==="; ollama pull qwen3:0.6b; echo "=== Setup complete ==="'
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'if command -v ollama > /dev/null 2>&1 && ! curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags > /dev/null 2>&1; then nohup ollama serve > /tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & fi'
